mcqs.question: Under the Tungabhadra water-sharing arrangement based on the KWDT award, what were the respective shares of Karnataka and undivided Andhra Pradesh?
mcqs.explanation: The KWDT award allocated 65% to Karnataka and 35% to undivided Andhra Pradesh. The tempting alternative reverses these percentages, while 15.9% was the allocation mentioned for Telangana, not undivided Andhra Pradesh.

mcqs.keyword: Policy period and mission launch year
mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly pairs Andhra Pradesh's Semiconductor and Display Fab Policy with the launch year of the India Semiconductor Mission?
mcqs.explanation: The Andhra Pradesh Semiconductor and Display Fab Policy covers 2024–2029, while the India Semiconductor Mission was launched in 2021. The other options either reverse the two details or assign the same period to both.
